name: CHAOS SPACE MARINES: RAPTORS
description:
Raptors are a subculture of sky warriors that cuts across Legion boundaries, hunting like avian predators, unified by the thrill of the chase. With screeching battle cries amplified to terrify their prey, they descend in meteoric charges, a flurry of reaping blades, and intense, short-ranged firepower.

Death from Above

This multipart plastic kit builds a squad of 5 Raptors, jump pack-equipped specialists for your Chaos Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Their combined speed and hitting power make them an excellent disruption and line-breaker unit that can engage the enemy quickly while the rest of your army advances. They can alternatively be built as Warp Talons, an elite unit that's dedicated solely to melee.

Assemble Your Squad

This highly customisable kit includes loads of weapon options to customise your miniatures, along with 10 accessories, 10 interchangeable shoulder pads, 10 interchangeable jump pack thrusters and fins, and 12 head options. The individual warriors can be armed as follows.

– 1 Raptor Champion armed with a bolt pistol or plasma pistol in the right hand, and a power sword, chainsword, or power fist on the left, or a massive chainaxe in both hands, as well as a unique head
– 1 Raptor armed with a bolt pistol or plasma pistol and chainsword, or a flamer
– 1 Raptor armed with a bolt pistol and chainsword, or a plasma gun, or a heavily mutated warrior
– 1 Raptor armed with a bolt pistol and chainsword, or a meltagun
– 1 Raptor armed with a bolt pistol or plasma pistol and chainsword, or a two-handed polearm

Contents:
– 160 plastic components
– 5 Citadel 32mm Round Bases
– 1 Chaos Space Marines Infantry Transfer Sheet
– 1 construction guide

The Chaos Space Marines Infantry Transfer Sheet features 364 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include transfers for the Black Legion, Thousand Sons, Word Bearers, Alpha Legion, Iron Warriors, and Night Lords. Each section features icons in various sizes to decorate your miniatures.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
